description: Defines template classes for strided random access iterators, including ConstStridedRandomAccessor and StridedRandomAccessor, with platform-specific __restrict__ modifiers.

classes.name: ConstStridedRandomAccessor
classes.description: A const random access iterator over a strided array.

classes.name: StridedRandomAccessor
classes.description: A mutable random access iterator over a strided array, inheriting from ConstStridedRandomAccessor.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to access the element.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the element.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element at a given index with stride.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Returns a new iterator advanced by an offset.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Returns a new iterator moved back by an offset.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Checks if one iterator is less than another.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if one iterator is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if one iterator is greater than another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one iterator is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Moves iterator back by an offset.
